LEGAL

TERMS OF USE

This website is for information only. Quotations are indicative and subject to confirmation, and every supply of product is governed by a separate written sale contract.

Contact PetroBind
Privacy Policy

Last updated: 3 September 2026

1. Who we are

This website is operated by PetroBind Global, a trading brand of Evevo Technologies Sdn. Bhd. (Company No. 202301008750 (1502671-K)), a company registered in Malaysia ("PetroBind", "we", "us"). Registered office: Level 28, The Gardens South Tower, Mid Valley City, Lingkaran Syed Putra, 59200 Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. You can contact us at sales@petrobindglobal.com.

2. The website is information only

The content of this website — including product descriptions, specification tables, application guidance, logistics information, and articles — is provided for general information. It is not advice, and it is not an offer capable of acceptance.

Nothing on this website creates a contract. Any supply of product is governed exclusively by a separate written sale contract signed by both parties.

3. Quotations

A quotation issued by PetroBind is an invitation to proceed, not a firm offer. Unless it states otherwise, a quotation is indicative, valid for the period stated on its face (and if none is stated, for 3 business days), and is in all cases subject to product availability, supplier confirmation, and PetroBind's written order confirmation.

Prices are market-linked and are quoted per enquiry against the specified grade, quantity, destination, packing, and Incoterm. PetroBind may withdraw or revise a quotation at any time before an order is confirmed.

4. Product information and specifications

Specification values shown on this website are typical reference ranges, not a commercial guarantee. Test methods (for example ASTM, EN, ISO, AASHTO, or IS designations) are named as references only; naming a method is not a statement that the product is certified or independently tested to it.

The Certificate of Analysis (COA) issued for the specific confirmed lot is the governing document for that shipment. Where a project requires conformity to a particular standard or independent testing, that must be agreed in writing in the sale contract.

Safety Data Sheet (SDS) summaries on this website are extracts. The full SDS for the supplied grade is provided on request and before shipment.

5. Pricing, payment and Incoterms

Pricing, the applicable Incoterm (Incoterms® 2020), payment instrument (telegraphic transfer or letter of credit), advance percentage, and any usance tenor are agreed and recorded in the sale contract before an order is finalised. Figures are not published on this website and are not a fixed public offer.

PetroBind does not offer trial or sample lots.

6. Inspection

Independent third-party pre-shipment inspection (for example, SGS or an equivalent agency) can be arranged at the buyer's request or where the sale contract requires it. Unless the contract says otherwise, inspection is arranged at the buyer's cost.

7. Sourcing

PetroBind acts as a principal trader and buys direct from its suppliers, with vetted packing and logistics partners. References to buying "direct from the supplier", to "origin", or to a supply region describe how PetroBind sources; they are not a warranty that goods are shipped directly from a named refinery or from any particular counterparty. The Certificate of Origin issued for a shipment states the actual origin for that cargo.

8. Intellectual property

The design, text, graphics, and layout of this website are owned by or licensed to PetroBind and may not be copied or reused without written permission. Third-party names and standards designations are the property of their respective owners and are used for identification only.

9. No warranty for the website; limitation of liability

The website is provided "as is". To the extent permitted by law, PetroBind gives no warranty that the website content is accurate, complete, or current, and excludes liability for any loss arising from reliance on website content.

Any liability in connection with the supply of product is as set out in the applicable sale contract and not in this website notice.

10. Governing law

These terms and any non-contractual obligations arising from them are governed by the laws of Malaysia, and the courts of Malaysia have jurisdiction, without prejudice to any dispute resolution clause agreed in a sale contract.

11. Changes

We may update these terms from time to time. The version published on this page applies to your use of the website.

Questions about these terms? Email sales@petrobindglobal.com or see the Privacy Policy.
